sources.title: AI Agent Builder Gumloop Lands $50M From Benchmark
sources.snippet: Gumloop already pivoted from basic task automation to full agent-building platform. That evolution matches AI capabilities maturing from 2023 to now. Next milestones: enterprise sales team delivery, customer case studies showing ROI, and retention metrics proving agents stick. Benchmark doesn't invest $50M for lifestyle businesses.
